name: heat-spreader-sizing-01
title: Heat Spreader Sizing 01 Fields
limitations: The source is a synthetic constant-property one-dimensional conduction case; passing does not establish physical thermal qualification.
Uniform end loading yields a linear field, so refinement agreement is a data-lineage check rather than independent validation of model physics.
excluded_scope: Convection, radiation, interfaces, fasteners, local chip footprint, temperature-dependent properties and transient behavior are outside the source model.
STEP geometry topology, manufacturing details and material procurement are not acceptance checks in this profile.

name: parametric-drill-jig-01
title: Parametric Drill Jig 01 Seat Geometry
limitations: The bounded STEP reader qualifies circular body-seat axes and diameters only; it does not establish full topology correspondence.
Synthetic bushing data are prototype inputs rather than supplier-certified dimensions.
excluded_scope: Flange-pocket applicability and bushing body-length stackup remain unresolved and are not acceptance checks.
Clamp access, datum-fence engagement, markings, DXF/STL correspondence and drilling-depth control are outside this bounded profile.
Manufacturing process capability, physical fit, retention, wear, strength and machining safety are not assessed.

name: structured-demo
title: Structured Demo
excluded_scope: Geometry, manufacture and physical fit are not assessed.
